caption:
The best seat in Grand Central comes with a shoeshine.

#newyorkcity #grandcentral #marblesculpture
alt_text: Under the green constellation ceiling and gold clock of Grand Central, a woman whose skin and carved updo are polished grey-ivory marble sits high in an oxblood leather shoeshine chair, wearing a lapis blazer, cream trousers and gold hoops, a red clutch in her hand.
